en: Fixed CLAUDE.md and rules files being sent to the model a second time, in most cases, after a session moves into a worktree under `.claude/worktrees` with EnterWorktree or is resumed there
zh: 修复在大多数情况下，session 通过 EnterWorktree 移入 `.claude/worktrees` 下的 worktree 或在该处恢复后，CLAUDE.md 和规则文件被第二次发送给模型的问题
